author: donotreviv3
body:
You're likely set as t7 grand dragoon class - >> can use weapons of the warrior and mage.. Not weapons of the theif such as bows. You won't be able to use bows again until tier 10 when you become a Beowulf that can use any gear. 

You are probably thinking oh I better change class lines so I can use a bow.. But don't. 

if you stay vallhallan you won't even really need a weapon at all most cases your pet should be doing most of your damage, especially when you switch to freyr at t8 and if you get there by the end of this month you can get the spirit garm which does some huge damage and only really needs you to buff magic stats. 

Change your spec to beast master and then tamer later on for even better damage and action rates from pets

author: Adventurous-Car8603
body:
Your class determines which gear you can use. T7 valhallan can use warrior and mage gear.

Both class and spec have preferred weapons, using 1 gives you a 5% weapon power bonus but not the ability to use them.

author: permaculturegeek
body:
Basically you've chosen a speciality that's not fully compatible with your class. Ranger is suited to shadowmancy line classes.
The ideal specialisation for valhallan is beast master, which boosts follower stats (50%!) and action rate.

From my limited experience playing thieves, none of the various bows are great weapons (there's always a blade which is better), and the game has no concept of ranged attack.

Finally,  Valhallan is very much a hybrid class, especially at higher tiers. I can't tell because the game only shows how much I lose at T7, but it's typical for base stat magic to be higher than attack. I shot ahead when I equipped spells rather than the equivalent physical skills and chose a hybrid weapon. Weapon preference ends up being instrument (hybrid) > staff > sword or axe.
